title: Crash exit from the 20-day high
text: The regime rules look 14-90 days back and leave late in a crash (2022: -23%). Exiting longs when BTC is X% below its 20-day high, and re-entering only when it recovers to X/2, should cut the crash years and cost little in bull years.

title: Volatility break halves longs
text: Crashes start with a volatility burst. When BTC's 7-day volatility exceeds k times its 90-day volatility, halve the longs.
fwd_note: 2026 read only, never used to decide

title: Fast trend guard
text: Hold longs only while BTC is above its short moving average (N days); a faster exit than the 50-200-day regime.

title: Short size
text: The half-size short was the only size tested beyond 25/50/100%. Scaling the short leg changes the bear years most.

title: Long size

title: Crowded funding halves longs
text: When BTC funding (7-day average) is above its trailing 1-year quantile q, longs are crowded and fragile: halve them.

title: Book drawdown brake
text: When the book itself is X below its 60-day high, halve all exposure: losses cluster.

title: Book stop
text: If the book lost more than X in 10 days, go flat for 5 days.

title: Long-term slope filter
text: Longs only while BTC's N-day average is rising (vs 10 days ago): avoids buying bear-market rallies.

title: Momentum-strength sizing
text: Scale longs by BTC's 30-day return / s, between 50% and 100%: full size only when the trend is strong.

title: Short only below the long average
text: Short only while BTC is below its N-day average: avoids shorting corrections inside bull markets (2024).

title: Short cover on a squeeze
text: Cover shorts when BTC rises X above its 10-day low; re-short when it falls back.

title: ETH/BTC switch
text: When ETH/BTC is below its N-day average, move the ETH long into BTC.

title: Rebalance band
text: Skip rebalances smaller than a band of total weight: saves costs without changing the signal.

title: Trade once a day

title: Short BTC instead of ETH

title: One-day crash exit
text: If BTC falls more than X in 24 hours, exit longs for 3 days.

title: Alt season switch
text: Altcoins move several times BTC, but only in alt seasons. When the equal-weight altcoin basket has beaten BTC by more than X over 30 days, move the long leg into the 5 strongest coins (90 days); otherwise stay in BTC+ETH.

title: Always part in the strongest alts
text: A fixed share of the long leg always in the 5 strongest coins (90 days), to capture alt rallies whenever the regime is long.

title: Broad rally -> all coins
text: When more than X of the top-14 coins are above their own 50-day average, the rally is broad and alts lead: move the long leg into the equal-weight basket.

title: ETH/BTC rising -> alts

title: Short altcoins in bear regimes
text: Alts fall several times BTC in bear markets (-58% in 2022 vs BTC -64% only at the end). Move a share of the short leg from BTC/ETH into the equal-weight altcoin basket.

title: Alt season with bigger size

title: Alt lead over N days -> coins in their own uptrend

title: Alts only at full regime

title: Full size whenever in a position
text: The volatility target keeps the book 34-67% invested. Whenever the book holds anything, scale the whole position (long or short) to p of capital: the signal decides direction, not size.

title: Higher volatility target
text: Multiply every position by k (a higher volatility target), never above 100% gross.

title: Full long leg
text: When the regime is long, hold the long leg at p of capital; shorts unchanged.

title: Never in cash
text: When the book is flat, hold BTC at p: average investment above 80% at all times.

title: Decision tree second layer
text: A depth-3 tree, trained each year only on earlier years (RSI, averages, crosses, volatility, funding, breadth, ETH/BTC), estimates whether the position's direction is right over the next 7 days. Where it has no confidence (probability < thr) the position is cut to `keep`. Out-of-sample it separated well in 2021, 2022 and 2025, not in 2023-2024.

title: Whipsaw filter from the loser autopsy
text: The losing longs (61% of trades, 2-18 days) enter with BTC barely above its 50-day average, that average falling and no support from the 200-day. Long only while BTC is more than p above its 200-day average AND the 50-day is rising. Derived from 2021-2025 trades: weaker evidence, the paper book is its real test.

title: Cooldown after a losing long
text: Whipsaws come in series. After a long trade that lost money, ignore new long signals for p days.
